labels.name: Femoral head
labels.function: Collapses in AVN after fracture or dislocation

labels.name: Femoral neck
labels.function: Common fragility fracture site after a low-energy fall

labels.name: Medial circumflex femoral artery
labels.function: Dominant adult supply to the head, about 85%

labels.name: Retinacular arteries
labels.function: Run up the neck to the head; torn by displaced fractures

labels.name: Lateral circumflex femoral artery
labels.function: Provides about 15% of the head's blood supply

labels.name: Artery of the ligamentum teres
labels.function: Main head supply in children; trivial in adults

labels.name: Iliopsoas
labels.function: Pulls a fractured femur up and into external rotation

labels.name: Lateral malleolus
labels.function: Fractured by inversion injuries

labels.name: Medial malleolus
labels.function: Pulled off transversely by an intact ligament in eversion

labels.name: Deltoid ligament
labels.function: Strong medial fan that can avulse a fragment of bone

labels.name: Talus
labels.function: Sits in the socket seen on mortise-view radiographs

labels.name: Medial tibial border
labels.function: Diffuse tenderness along it in shin splints

labels.name: Calcaneus
labels.function: Fall onto the heels; look for a thoracolumbar fracture

labels.name: Tarsometatarsal joint
labels.function: Fracture-dislocation here from axial load on a pointed foot

labels.name: Proximal fifth metatarsal
labels.function: Watershed junction; fractures here heal poorly (nonunion)

labels.name: Popliteal artery
labels.function: Tethered above and below; torn in knee dislocation

labels.name: Dorsalis pedis artery
labels.function: Pulse on the top of the foot; check after any dislocation

labels.name: Posterior tibial artery
labels.function: Ankle pulse that is absent in acute limb ischemia

labels.name: Knee joint
labels.function: Keeping it retains active flexion and extension

labels.name: Above-knee amputation level
labels.function: Prosthetic gait needs substantially more energy

labels.name: Below-knee amputation level
labels.function: Prosthetic gait needs a moderate increase in energy

labels.name: Transmetatarsal amputation level
labels.function: Relatively minor effect on walking energy
